Native R recurrence networks, joint recurrence and sliding-window RQA

etr_native_nonlinear_recurrence.Rd

Ten native Python-independent nonlinear-dynamics algorithms and frames based on the published eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0 contracts from recurrence.py, recurrence_networks.py and joint_recurrence.py. These are research-size native R implementations, not Python scipy.sparse object wrappers. Recurrence-network results can now optionally use sparse native Matrix adjacency and accept already sparse native recurrence matrices without materializing a dense square array. Native joint RQA on sparse sources now counts diagonal and vertical line runs directly from nonzero coordinates, including large sparse recurrence systems, without the former 2500-node dense-conversion guard.

Usage

etr_recurrence_network(recurrence, adjacency_storage = c("dense", "sparse"),
  python_boundary_mode = FALSE)
etr_recurrence_network_node_frame(result)
etr_recurrence_network_summary_frame(result)
etr_joint_recurrence_matrix(recurrences, labels = NULL)
etr_joint_recurrence_component_frame(result)
etr_joint_rqa_metrics(result, min_diagonal_length = 2L,
                      min_vertical_length = 2L)
etr_cross_rqa_metrics(recurrence, min_diagonal_length = 2L,
                      min_vertical_length = 2L)
etr_recurrence_radius_profile(source, curve = 1L, radii,
  metric = "euclidean", theiler_window = 0L,
  theiler_window_units = "samples", dimensions = NULL)
etr_windowed_rqa(trajectories, curve = 1L, window, step,
  window_units = "samples", step_units = "samples", radius = NULL,
  target_recurrence_rate = NULL, metric = "euclidean",
  theiler_window = 0L, theiler_window_units = "samples",
  dimensions = NULL, min_diagonal_length = 2L,
  min_vertical_length = 2L)
etr_windowed_rqa_trajectory_set(trajectories, metrics, window, step,
  window_units = "samples", step_units = "samples", radius = NULL,
  target_recurrence_rate = NULL, metric = "euclidean",
  theiler_window = 0L, theiler_window_units = "samples",
  dimensions = NULL, min_diagonal_length = 2L,
  min_vertical_length = 2L, undefined_policy = "raise")

Arguments

recurrence

Native etr_recurrence, auto for network analysis and cross for cross-RQA.

adjacency_storage

"dense" keeps the existing native logical adjacency matrix and its 2500-node cap; "sparse" returns a logical sparse Matrix matrix with a 10000-node cap for dense source recurrence or 100000 nodes when the source is already sparse. The Matrix package is required only for sparse input or output.

result

Native recurrence network or joint recurrence result.

recurrences

Two or more native auto-recurrence results on exactly the same time grid, temporal unit and Theiler-exclusion contract.

labels

Optional unique component labels.

min_diagonal_length,min_vertical_length

Positive integer minimum qualifying RQA line lengths.

source,trajectories

Complete native etr_trajectory_set; the first supplies a radius-profile source.

curve

One-based numeric curve index or existing curve identifier.

radii

Prespecified strictly increasing positive finite radius vector.

metric

Source recurrence metric: "euclidean", "cityblock", or "chebyshev", including windowed RQA.

theiler_window

Nonnegative excluded sample-index lag.

theiler_window_units

Sample units or convertible physical-time units on an approximately regular observed grid.

dimensions

Optional distinct named channel selection.

window,step

Window and step lengths in explicit sample or physical units, resolved to whole observed samples; windows need at least three samples and step <= window.

window_units,step_units

Sample units or convertible physical-time units without resampling or interpolation.

radius

Optional positive finite fixed recurrence radius. Specify exactly one of radius or target_recurrence_rate.

target_recurrence_rate

Optional target density strictly between zero and one. Uses source-aligned inclusive-radius threshold selection, whose achieved rate may differ because of distance ties. When this controls the density, recurrence_rate cannot be a derived outcome.

metrics

Distinct named RQA metrics forming functional channels.

undefined_policy

"raise" to reject undefined RQA metrics or "keep" to preserve them as explicit missing values.

python_boundary_mode

If TRUE, use the published Python 1.2 boundary conditions; FALSE retains native validation defaults.

Value

etr_recurrence_network() returns a native etr_recurrence_network list with undirected adjacency, zero-based connected-component labels, degree, clustering, transitivity and provenance. Node and summary functions return native R data frames. Joint functions return a native etr_joint_recurrence or per-component table/line statistics. etr_recurrence_radius_profile() returns an etr_recurrence_radius_profile list with cumulative and shell recurrence fractions. etr_windowed_rqa() returns a native etr_windowed_rqa with one row per complete window and explicit dropped-tail count. etr_windowed_rqa_trajectory_set() returns an etr_windowed_rqa_functional with functional native trajectory, per-curve windows, overlap fraction and provenance.

Details

These functions are discrete, not continuous-time estimators. Recurrence-network transitivity is undefined (NaN) when there are no connected triples; clustering for degree below two is zero. No automatic graph threshold or community detection is performed. Joint recurrence requires strictly synchronized input and does not resample, shift, or harmonize component thresholds.

Dense recurrence network output is limited to 2500 state nodes; opt-in sparse output supports up to 10000 native recurrence states, retaining source topology but not SciPy CSR class identity. Native sparse Matrix auto-recurrence inputs can be analyzed without dense allocation (with a separately bounded 100000-node sparse network path); joint recurrence can intersect synchronized dense/sparse sources. Native line-RQA uses sparse coordinates for large auto, joint and rectangular cross recurrence inputs. Python SciPy CSR and typed result identity and full source error domains remain unresolved. Native radius profiles retain their separate 2500-node limit. These caps differ from Python's sparse implementations. Radius profiles accept convertible physical-time Theiler windows and TrajectorySet input. Windowed RQA supports fixed-radius or explicitly requested target-density thresholds, all three source distance metrics, and convertible physical-time windows/steps on approximately regular grids. Target-density selection is not an independent parity certificate. The current R objects are partial scientific-result representations, not certified binary/serialization equivalents of Python dataclasses.

Windowed functional RQA reuses source samples for overlapping windows and does NOT treat windows as independent sampling units for downstream inference. No scientific coverage or inferential calibration is implied. Optional Python reference tests use a pinned Python 1.2 package and are entirely separate from the native R algorithms.

Native sparse cross-RQA accepts rectangular sparse Matrix recurrence inputs with explicitly declared first and second time grids. Cross-line statistics use all diagonals and vertical lines and require approximately regular and matching time-step sizes. Native sparse representations are not identical to Python SciPy CSR or typed dataclass results.

Examples

values <- array(0,c(2L,9L,1L))
values[1L,,1L] <- rep(0:2,3L)
values[2L,,1L] <- rep(c(0,1,0),3L)
x <- etr_trajectory_set(0:8,values,c("A","B"),"x",time_unit="s")
r1 <- etr_recurrence_matrix(x,"A",radius=0.01)
r2 <- etr_recurrence_matrix(x,"B",radius=0.01)
network <- etr_recurrence_network(r1)
joint <- etr_joint_recurrence_matrix(list(r1,r2))
report <- etr_joint_rqa_metrics(joint)
